jobs.name: KitSheet3Coral
jobs.prompt: Using the attached castle concept as the exact style and design reference, draw a clean prop sheet of separate game props taken from it, arranged in a 2 by 2 grid with lots of empty space between them. Each prop is whole, isolated, centered in its own quarter, three-quarter view from slightly above, on a plain light gray background, even studio lighting, no ground, no shadows, no castle walls, no text or labels. Match the reference exactly: stylized semi-realistic low-poly Roblox game assets, smooth shading, solid color regions. Top left: a single branching sea fan coral, a flat lacy fan shape on a short stalk on a small rock, the coral pale cream-white with no color. Top right: a cluster of five tall tube corals of different heights with open rims, on a small rock, the corals pale cream-white with no color. Leave the other quarters empty.
